name: Deliver Supplies
desc: Carry crates of grain and ore to a branch outpost.

outcomes.text: The delivery arrives on time and the steward is pleased.

name: Patrol the Borders
desc: Walk the sect's boundary stones and report anything strange.

outcomes.text: You scare off a pack of wolves before they reach a village.
A quiet patrol. The captain nods and logs your service.

name: Guard the Scripture Pavilion
desc: Stand watch through long nights beside the sect's archives.

outcomes.text: Between watches you read a stray scroll and glimpse a deeper truth.
The nights pass slowly but without incident.

name: Tend the Spirit Gardens
desc: Weed, water and harvest the sect's spirit herb beds.

outcomes.text: A rare herb sprouts under your care, and the keeper lets you take a share.
Honest work and honest wages.

name: Hunt a Rogue Beast
desc: A spirit beast has been raiding the sect's farmland.

outcomes.text: You slay the beast and bring back its core.
The beast mauls you before you drive it off.

name: Escort a Caravan
desc: Guard a merchant caravan carrying the sect's goods across bandit country.

outcomes.text: Bandits spot the caravan, think twice and melt away.
An ambush! You hold the road, but not without wounds.

name: Lead a Squad
desc: Command a handful of junior disciples on a cleansing patrol.

outcomes.text: Your squad works as one, and the elders take note of you.
Your orders cost the squad dearly. You carry the blame and the scars.

name: Seal a Spirit Rift
desc: A tear in the veil leaks wild qi. Help the formation masters close it.

outcomes.text: The formation holds. Stray qi soaks into your meridians as the rift closes.
The rift flares and scorches you.

name: Defend the Sect Gates
desc: A rival band is testing the sect's defenses. Hold the gate.

outcomes.text: You hold the gate through a bloody night. The elders will remember it.
The gate holds, but you are carried off the field half dead.

name: Strike at a Hidden Stronghold
desc: Join a strike team against a fortified enemy stronghold.

outcomes.text: The stronghold falls and the spoils are shared out.
The strike is repelled. You escape but barely.

name: Protect a Village
desc: A mortal village begs for protection from wandering demons.

outcomes.text: The villagers weep with thanks as you drive off the threat.
You save the village, but not without a price.

name: Heal the Plague-Stricken
desc: A plague spreads through the valley towns. Lend your qi to the healers.

outcomes.text: Weeks of tireless work leave you drained but respected.

name: Hunt Demonic Cultivators
desc: Track a gang of blood cultivators to their hideout.

outcomes.text: You break the gang and rescue their captives.
They were stronger than the scouts reported.

name: Collect Tribute
desc: Squeeze the sect's due out of the nearby towns.

outcomes.text: Doors shut as you pass, but the coin purse is full.

name: Raid a Rival Outpost
desc: Strike a rival sect's outpost at night and take what you can.

outcomes.text: The outpost burns and the loot is yours to share.
The defenders were waiting for you.

name: Harvest Blood Essence
desc: Gather a dark essence the elders prize, from sources best left unnamed.

outcomes.text: The elders approve. The essence sings in your blood.
The essence rebels and scars your meridians.

name: Gather Rare Herbs
desc: Scour the misty cliffs for the herbs the alchemists need.

outcomes.text: You find a stand of rare herbs and keep a few for yourself.
A long day on the cliffs yields a respectable basket.

name: Assist the Alchemist
desc: Tend the cauldron fires for a master through a long brewing.

outcomes.text: You notice a flaw in the recipe, and the master is impressed.
Hours at the fire teach you patience and burn your sleeves.

name: Test a New Pill
desc: The pavilion needs a volunteer to try an untested pill.

outcomes.text: The pill works wonderfully, and you are paid handsomely.
The pill disagrees with you violently.
